blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Rodante Marcoleta on Thursday said he is “happy” as he noted that former President Rodrigo Duterte appeared to be in good condition after appearing before the International Criminal Court (ICC) for the first time. Marcoleta made the remarks after his bail hearing for plunder at the Sandiganbayan Third Division, which allowed the interview to be conducted inside the courtroom. The senator, who is currently behind bars at Payatas jail, said he only saw Duterte after someone showed him the pictures from social media.
